context.label: Questions, testimony, and authority

observations.body: After Jesus prays, a disciple asks him to teach them to pray as John also taught his disciples, and Jesus gives them words of prayer.
observations.label: A disciple remembers that John taught prayer

observations.body: The passage presents Praying, asking, and teaching as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Praying, asking, and teaching

observations.body: The passage places John taught his disciples to pray beside Praying, asking, and teaching.
observations.label: John taught his disciples to pray

payload.posture: Read Luke 11:1–4 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states after Jesus prays, a disciple asks him to teach them to pray as John also taught his disciples, and Jesus gives them words of prayer. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
payload.title: A disciple remembers that John taught prayer
